flyktingarna_vargstigen.namn: The Refugees on the Wolf Trail
flyktingarna_vargstigen.vilka: A family from an emptied village in the east, pulling a cart towards the camp. They have walked for nine days.

heddas_jaktlag.vilka: Three hunters from Wolfstead sent out by Hedda for meat. They took a grey wolf and drew the pack.

kolarfamiljen.namn: The Collier Family at the Kiln
kolarfamiljen.vilka: Tor the Collier's cousins, who refused to leave the kiln. They burn charcoal to trade for food at the camp.

avfallingarna.namn: The Deserters from the Ash Road
avfallingarna.vilka: Two young people who fled the Children of Ash in Ashenhold. They burned their robes but still carry the cult marks on their hands.

likbararna.vilka: Two of Bror's men who carry the dead home from the forest to the camp's grave crosses. They have a bier and a lantern.

gravvaktarnas_patrull.vilka: Two of the last Gravewardens, trying to keep the barrows shut. Ebbe believes they are dead.
